panel_reliability.coverage_basis: current period filers over the larger of the two periods' filer counts
panel_reliability.form: reliability = panel_stability * coverage / (1 + abs(panel_drift_z)); panel derived inputs are discounted by the reliability
panel_reliability.missing_input: a third full filing period on record (the 2026-09-30 period, whose filings arrive after this record's two periods): with two periods there is one stability reading and no earlier series to take a z against, so no drift figure is computed or substituted
panel_reliability.note: No drift series exists yet: two filing periods are on record and a drift z needs a series of panel readings. The composition snapshot for this period pair is recorded in panel-history.json from this refresh on, so the series can be built; until it exists, no holder count here is discounted and none is presented as discounted.
panel_reliability.panel_drift_state: undefined: one period pair on record; a drift z needs a series of at least three panel readings with varying earlier readings
panel_reliability.stability_basis: Jaccard overlap of the filing manager sets of the two periods on record
